explanation: erdosproblems.com/664: Alon's construction has |A_i| ≥ (2/5)√n with n = q²+q+1. The Lean statement is the negated bounded-blocking claim specialised to c = 2/5 with strict inequality 2/5·√n < |A_i|. Since q² < n < (q+1)², √n is irrational, so ≥ and > coincide for Alon's sets and the statement follows from his result. Faithful.
